name: Woodbury Common Premium Outlets
summary: Woodbury Common Premium Outlets is one of America's largest outlet shopping destinations, featuring 250 brand-name stores offering 25-65% off retail prices in an open-air setting. Located in New York's Hudson Valley, this premier outlet center attracts millions of shoppers annually from around the world seeking luxury and premium brands at exceptional values.
demographics: Woodbury Common Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of domestic and international tourists, with a significant proportion of visitors from New York City and the tri-state area, as well as international shoppers from Canada, Europe, and Asia. The center draws middle to upper-middle income households seeking value on premium brands, with a strong representation of families and millennial shoppers aged 25-45. The trade area extends well beyond the local Woodbury community, functioning as a regional destination that captures tourists traveling along the I-87 corridor between New York City and upstate destinations, with visitors typically making planned shopping trips and spending 3-4 hours browsing the extensive outlet offerings.
description: Woodbury Common Premium Outlets stands as one of the largest and most successful outlet shopping destinations in the United States, featuring an impressive collection of 250 brand-name stores spread across an expansive open-air village setting in the scenic Hudson Valley. Located just an hour north of New York City in Woodbury, New York, this premier outlet center has become a must-visit destination for both domestic and international shoppers seeking significant savings on luxury and premium brands. The center's carefully curated tenant mix includes high-end designers and popular lifestyle brands, offering discounts of 25% to 65% off retail prices on everything from fashion and accessories to home goods and sporting equipment. With its convenient location near major highways and its reputation for exceptional value, Woodbury Common has evolved into more than just a shopping center—it's a full-day experience that attracts millions of visitors annually from around the world. The property's thoughtfully designed layout, ample parking, and comprehensive amenities including dining options and visitor services make it an unparalleled outlet shopping destination in the Northeast.
